ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels; dark pixels are primarily concentrated in a central vertical band.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a wide, upward-tapering wedge originating from the peduncle and extending to the median notch. The lateral lobes are predominantly light with high-frequency, low-diameter dark speckling distributed across the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with an obtuse interior angle; depth is approximately 5-8% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe (viewer perspective) shows more pronounced, irregular peak-to-valley variations than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a consistent convex curvature along the trailing edge, terminating in sharply defined, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular dark pixel groups (3-5 pixels in diameter) are visible across the high-intensity regions of both lobes, particularly near the distal tips.
